C9000314.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 314 (Cyclic length and chromatic fixed-point loss.; papers: Cyclic length and chromatic fixed-point loss; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

P_CHROMATIC.statement: Manuscript thm:main: r_n(G,H)=ell(G,H) for all finite p-group pairs and n>=0; unverified here.

P_CHARACTERS.statement: Manuscript thm:pro-characters constructs the profinite source and natural evaluation splitting; unverified here.

P_CONGRUENCES.statement: Manuscript lem:hom-integrality and thm:subgroup-congruence give every arithmetic hypothesis for that source; unverified here.

P_RATIONAL_GLUING.statement: Manuscript cor:rational-gluing; application remains unverified because its character inputs are open.

P_HIGHER_GLUING.statement: Manuscript higher-height gluing estimate and product-series rank subtraction; unverified here.

P_SUPPORT.statement: Manuscript subgroup support separation argument; unverified here.

P_PROCYCLIC.statement: Under the exact three hypotheses of thm:procyclic, Gamma has a closed subnormal Z_p series of length at most l.

P_FIRST_QUOTIENT.statement: Cyclic-target homomorphism-count integrality forces a nontrivial finitely generated pro-p group to map onto Z_p.

P_KERNEL.statement: Manuscript lem:kernel-abelianization follows from the effective integral detector obstruction.

P_GRAPH_COUNT.statement: Actual graph subgroups correspond bijectively to (V,W,f) with V normal open, W open, and f:W onto K/V; the index is [K:V][Z_p^d:W], with no automorphism denominator.

P_QUOTIENT_SUM.statement: For finite abelian A of order p^b, sum over B<=A of |Sur(Z_p^d,A/B)| equals p^(bd).

P_LATTICE.statement: The lattice generating function is product_(u=0)^(d-1)(1-p^u t)^(-1); D_d a_j(d)=1 mod p^(j+1).

P_EFFECTIVE.statement: If |K^ab|=p^b and d>=1, then D_d c_h=p^(bd) mod p^(h-b+1) for h>=b, and v_p(c_h)=bd for h>=b(d+1).

P_DETECTOR.statement: For F=K/Phi(K) of order p^r, |F|e_F is integral and its inflated congruence sum at h=b(d+1) is p^r c_h, not divisible by p^(h+1).

P_SHRINK.statement: Shrinking a split Z_p action transfers all open-subgroup finite-set congruences and the finite-section rank bound to N x Z_p^(d+1).

P_SECTION_RANK.statement: The finite-section generator bound makes each closed kernel finitely generated and forces termination by the quotient (C_p)^(d+1).

P_LEAN_CORE.statement: For p>=2, d=n+1, arbitrary integer weights summing to p^(bd), and h>=b(d+1), the recursively defined graph count is divisible by p^(bd) but not p^(bd+1); for r<=b the scaled count at h=b(d+1) is not divisible by p^(h+1). Universal lattice stabilization and denominator cancellation are proved too.
P_LEAN_CORE.remaining_obligation: Formal claim is closed_kernel; independent review of statement fidelity and its group-theoretic interpretation remains.
